jobs.description:
**Abode**, one of the largest and effective nonprofits working to end homelessness in the Bay Area, is seeking a **Housing Specialist** for our programs in Napa County.


**About The Role**: The **Housing Specialist** is responsible for locating housing units, working closely with landlords, collaborating with service providers, and providing general housing support to ensure that homeless individuals and/or families can secure and maintain housing.


**The People and Culture**: You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams \- people you can be proud to work with! Abode Services regularly recognizes employees’ efforts, seeks employees’ input, and cares for employees as people with lives outside of work. We believe that we make better decisions and provide quality services when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. People of color make up nearly 70% of our workforce and we strive to recruit and retain employees from all backgrounds.  

  

**Our Benefits \& Perks:**


* **$28\.85 \- $31\.74 per hour**
* 100% paid health, vision, and dental options
* 19 PTO days \& 12 Holidays per year
* Voluntary benefits: FSA, EAP, Commuter Checks, Life Insurance, Legal, and more

About California Support Services

**California Support Services** is a community\-focused organization dedicated to empowering California communities through comprehensive wraparound services. Our programs support individuals facing challenges, from education and employment to mental health and housing, helping them build resilience and achieve self\-sufficiency. Over the past 10 years, we have made a measurable difference in the lives of over 7,300 individuals in Contra Costa County. Join our team and be part of a mission\-driven organization that values impact, growth, and community.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dedicated and energetic Lead Care Manager/Housing Navigator to join our team on a full\-time or part\-time basis. In this vital role, you will serve as a compassionate advocate and expert resource for individuals experiencing homelessness or housing instability. Your leadership will help connect clients with housing assistance programs, social services, and community resources, ensuring they receive comprehensive support tailored to their unique needs. This position offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact in underserved communities by guiding clients through complex systems and advocating for their housing stability and well\-being.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead case management efforts by developing individualized service plans that address clients’ housing, health, and social needs.
* Act as a primary point of contact for clients, providing ongoing client communication and crisis intervention when necessary.

* Collaborate with landlords, property managers, and community partners to negotiate lease agreements while ensuring compliance with Fair Housing laws and landlord\-tenant law.
* Conduct assessments related to high\-risk populations, including individuals with mental health conditions or substance use challenges, utilizing motivational interviewing and crisis management techniques.
* Maintain detailed records using property management tools like OneSite and document all interactions in accordance with social services standards.
* Provide training or mentorship to team members on culturally competent care practices and effective client engagement strategies.

**Skills**

* Strong negotiation skills to facilitate lease agreements and resolve conflicts effectively.
* Expertise in crisis intervention, crisis management, and addiction counseling techniques.
* Knowledge of landlord\-tenant law, Fair Housing regulations, and HUD policies related to housing assistance programs.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and property management software such as OneSite.
* Experience working with culturally diverse communities and underserved populations experiencing homelessness or housing insecurity.
* Ability to support high\-risk populations through case management strategies tailored to mental health conditions or substance use issues.
* Excellent client communication skills combined with motivational interviewing techniques to foster trust and engagement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, Nursing, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in case management, social services, or a related field.
* In\-depth knowledge of local health and social service resources in Contra Costa County.
* Strong proficiency in care coordination principles, electronic health records, and case management software.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills; bilingual abilities are a plus.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.

**Why Join Us?** At California Support Services, we’re committed to transforming lives by offering comprehensive support that builds resilience and independence. Join us to make a meaningful impact in California communities.

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

**About Us**

At Sacramento Dry Eye Clinic, we are more than a traditional eye care clinic—we are a specialty dry eye center dedicated to identifying and treating the root cause of chronic dry eye disease. Our mission is to provide compassionate, personalized care while helping our patients achieve lasting relief and an improved quality of life.

We are looking for a caring, motivated, and detail\-oriented **Patient Care Coordinator \& Dry Eye Specialist** to become an integral part of our growing team. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys building relationships with patients, educating others, and delivering an exceptional patient experience from the first phone call through long\-term follow\-up.

**Position Summary**

The Patient Care Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for our patients throughout their dry eye journey. This role combines patient education, clinical support, scheduling coordination, treatment assistance, and concierge\-level customer service to ensure every patient feels heard, supported, and cared for.

No prior dry eye experience is required—we are happy to train the right individual who is passionate about helping others.

**ResponsibilitiesPatient Experience**

* Welcome patients with warmth, professionalism, and offer refreshments.
* Coordinate the patient journey from consultation through ongoing treatment.
* Build meaningful relationships with patients and provide compassionate support.
* Answer patient questions regarding dry eye disease and treatment plans.
* Conduct follow\-up phone calls to monitor patient progress.
* Build relationships with referring doctors and send summary reports for patient updates.
* Help patients understand recommended treatment options and home care.

**Clinical Support**

* Assist the doctor during prior to dry eye evaluations such as retrieving consent forms and uploading them into patient charts.
* Ensure treatment rooms and equipment are prepared the day before a clinic day.
* Assist with patient education on dry eye diagnostic testing and procedures, including:
* Diagnostic Testing:
* Schirmer’s Test
* InflammaDry MMP9 Test
* Meibography
* Lissamine and Fluorescein Evaluation
* Tear Break Up Time
* Corneal Sensitivity Testing
* Eyelid Evaluation for Demodex build up and blink rate and function
* Treatment Procedures:
* Intense Pulsed Light (IPL)
* Meibomian gland expression with forceps
* Red light therapy
* Punctal plug procedures \- LacriFill
* Eyelid Cleaning \- Blephex and Rinsada
* Scleral lens education
* Amniotic Membrane
* Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP) Eye drops
* Assist patients after Dry Eye evaluations and treatment with post\-care, including:
* Providing a summary of treatment recommendations by the doctor
* Be familiar with products to dispense after their visit which include:
* Lubricating eye drops
* Heated Eye Compress
* Safe non\-toxic cosmetic products
* Eyelid Hygiene products
* Dry Eye Supplements
* Dry Eye Glasses
* Have general knowledge of prescription eye drops commonly used for Dry Eyes:
* Cyclosporines: Restasis, Cequa, Vevye
* Neuromodulators: Tyrvya, Tryptyr
* Anti\-Inflammatories: Xiidra, Steroids, PRP
* Lubricants: Miebo, Ivizia

**Patient Education**

* Educate patients on:
* Dry eye disease
* Meibomian gland dysfunction
* Aqueous Deficiency
* Ocular Inflammation \+ Rosacea
* Home treatment recommendations
* Nutrition and lifestyle modifications
* Cosmetic hygiene
* Environmental changes

**Practice Growth**

* Participate in community outreach and educational events.
* Help organize patient workshops and seminars.
* Assist with patient testimonials (with consent).
* Contribute ideas to improve patient experience and clinic operations.

**Qualifications**

Preferred:

* Experience in optometry, ophthalmology, healthcare, or medical assisting.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Comfortable using electronic health records (EHR).
* Passion for patient education and customer service.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

**What We're Looking For**

We are searching for someone who is:

* Compassionate and patient\-centered
* Professional and dependable
* Detail\-oriented
* Organized
* Team\-oriented
* Eager to learn new skills
* Passionate about improving patients' lives

**What We Offer**

* Opportunities for career growth
* Supportive and collaborative work environment
* Meaningful relationships with patients
* The opportunity to make a lasting difference in the lives of people suffering from chronic dry eye disease

If you love helping others, enjoy learning, and want to be part of a practice focused on excellence and compassionate care, we would love to hear from you!

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dedicated and energetic Resident Care Coordinator to join our dynamic healthcare team. In this vital role, you will serve as a compassionate advocate for residents, ensuring their care plans are effectively implemented and their needs are met with professionalism and empathy. Your leadership will help foster a safe, respectful, and engaging environment for residents across various care settings. This position offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals requiring specialized care, including those with complex medical conditions or developmental disabilities. The Medical Assistant Care Coordinator ensures that patients empaneled to a Care Team receive the appropriate services per their healthcare plan. The Care Coordinator will work alongside the providers and the care team to identify and address the needs of patients assigned to the care team. This position will coordinate the population health process for the care team while promoting patient\-centered care.

  



***MAJOR POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES AND FUNCTIONS:***

Determine gaps in care and initiate the implementation of next steps for all standing order items. **Do you have 10 years of medical office experience and want to join an organization that values your dedication to patient care, recognizes your expertise, and supports your professional growth and long\-term success? If so, we encourage you to apply today and learn more about joining our team.**

As a Patient Care Coordinator (PCC), you will be the welcoming face of our clinic, creating exceptional experiences for every patient who walks through our doors. In this role, you will oversee daily clinic operations, build strong patient relationships, understand and address patients' hearing healthcare needs, and help ensure the continued success and growth of the practice.  


**What You’ll Do**


* Greet and screen patients to determine how we can best support them
* Answer questions about services and promotions
* Spot potential leads and keep patient flow running smoothly
* Manage scheduling, daily office tasks, and financial and administrative duties
* Handle insurance verification, inventory, and patient records
* Partner with clinic and home office teams to support operations
* Assist with marketing efforts, events, outreach, and patient retention activities

 **Who Thrives in This Role**


* Eager learners whose career is centered around working in a medical practice
* Strong multi\-taskers with solid problem\-solving skills
* Punctual, reliable professionals
* Individuals who genuinely love helping others in the medical industry while running a thriving practice

* $19\.00 \- $20\.00 an hour. Pay is commensurate with experience and qualifications

* Coordinate provider’s schedule and ensure the smooth and efficient flow of patient care while in the office.

* Responsible to open and close the office on a daily basis and ensure the reception area is well maintained.
* Training support for other location front office staff, as may be appropriate.

 **Education and Experience Requirements**:


* A minimum of 10 years of medical office management experience
* Experience with front desk in the hearing industry is a plus
* High school diploma or equivalent (GED)

 **Required Skills:**


* Strong computer skills
* Experience with word processing and database software.
* Excellent interpersonal skills that allow effective working relationships with a diverse, patient, colleague, and vendor population. This includes listening, sales and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Basic understanding of accounting procedures and good math aptitude.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks within strict deadlines.
* Ability to input and track sales revenues and balance accounts daily and monthly.
* Detail oriented.
* Front desk medical experience required.

 **Physical Demands:**


* Ability to handle a busy office with interruptions, calls, walk\-ins and direct the flow of the office with efficiency and grace.
* Must be able to pick up after an interruption to complete tasks that require focus.
* Must be able to lift boxes up to 20 pounds.

jobs.title: Senior Complex Case Manager (RN) - D-SNP
jobs.description:
**OUR COMMITMENT TO A HUMAN HIRING PROCESS**



We believe every candidate deserves thoughtful consideration. That's why we do not use AI or automated systems to review applications. Every application is reviewed by a real human member of our team. Because we take the time to give each submission the attention it deserves, our review process may take a little longer — and we genuinely appreciate your patience as we work through applications carefully and respectfully.


**SERVICE AREA PREFERENCE**



While we encourage all interested applicants to apply, we do give priority to those who live in, or near, our service counties: Santa Cruz, Monterey, Merced, San Benito, and Mariposa. Our mission of *accessible, quality health care guided by local innovation*leads everything we do, and having team members who are connected to the communities we serve strengthens our ability to deliver on that commitment.



There are 2 positions available as a Senior Complex Case Manager (RN) within the Care Management Department at the Alliance.


#### **WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**



Reporting to the Medicare Care Management Manager (RN), this position:


* Develops and manages an individualized comprehensive plan of care for Medicare Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D\-SNP) members referred into the Case Management Program with the goal of promoting optimal, achievable outcomes in the most cost effective and appropriate manner
* Works with and educates members, families, providers, external agencies, and internal departments on the D\-SNP Case Management Program
* Participates in Quality Improvement studies, to continually evaluate the program's effectiveness and ability in promoting quality driven, cost effective, achievable goals and outcomes for members
* Performs D\-SNP Program oversight and support activities
* Acts as a liaison between the D\-SNP Program and providers and community agencies to promote effective implementation of program objectives and requirements

#### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Care Management Department's mission is to coordinate care and empower members to achieve their health and wellness goals through collaboration and by facilitating member relationships with community providers. We bring the voice of the member into the room when collaborating with our fellow departments at the Alliance.


**WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL**



To read the full position description, and list of requirements click here.


* **Knowledge of:**
* + The principles and practices of clinical nursing
	+ The principles and practices of case management, including motivational interviewing and evidence\-based guidelines
	+ Care management and coordination
	+ Complex chronic conditions, geriatric care, and psychosocial factors impacting health outcomes
	+ The principles and practices of developing and implementing health improvement strategies to address social determinants of health
	+ Evidence\-based practice guidelines in the development of care plans
	+ Electronic health record and/or care management platforms
* **Ability to:**
	+ Assess member risk, define problems, develop care plans, and collaborate across disciplines
	+ Demonstrate strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills
	+ Interpret and apply policies and regulations
	+ Define issues, conduct research, interpret data, and identify and evaluate options
	+ Evaluate medical records and other health care data
	+ Organize work, manage complex priorities, and document with accuracy and timeliness
	+ Communicate effectively with a diverse population of members, including those with behavioral health issues
* **Education and Experience:**
	+ Current unrestricted license as a Registered Nurse issued by the State of California
	+ Associate's degree in Nursing and a minimum of seven years of experience in a patient care setting, including a minimum of one year of case management experience (a Bachelor's degree may substitute for two years of the required experience); or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be qualifying
	+ A minimum of one year of the required patient care experience must be in an acute or outpatient environment, working with adults and/or dual\-eligible populations

#### **OTHER INFORMATION**


* We are in a hybrid work environment, and we anticipate that the interview process will take place remotely via Microsoft Teams.
* While some staff may work full telecommuting schedules, attendance at quarterly company\-wide events or department meetings will be expected.
* In\-office or in\-community presence may be required for some positions and is dependent on business need. Details about this can be reviewed during the interview process.


**COMPENSATION INFORMATION**


* **Zone 1 Pay Range: $125K \- $140K**  

Typical areas in Zone 1: Santa Cruz, San Benito, and Monterey Counties, Bay Area, Sacramento, Los Angeles and San Diego areas
* **Zone 2 Pay Range: $120K \- $135K**  

Typical areas in Zone 2: Mariposa and Merced Counties, Fresno area, Bakersfield, Eastern California, San Luis Obispo area, and the Central Valley (except Sacramento)


The applicable salary ranges are based on work location and are aligned to a zone according to the cost of labor in your area. All ranges are subject to change in the future. We are happy to provide the full compensation range for the role, answer any questions that you have, or share the applicable pay zone for your location if it's not one of the typical areas listed. You can reach out to careers@thealliance.health, and a member from our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.



The hiring ranges represent a good‑faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role upon hire and are not the full compensation ranges. Employees typically have opportunities for growth within the full compensation range over time based on performance and merit. Final compensation will be determined by our compensation philosophy, analysis of the selected candidate's qualification

Monarqui Aesthetics \& Wellness is seeking a dependable, polished, organized, and personable Patient Care Coordinator (PCC)/ Medical Assistant to join our growing aesthetics and wellness practice.

This is a hybrid position combining patient coordination, front\-office operations, customer service, sales, and Medical Assistant responsibilities.

The ideal candidate is confident communicating with patients, managing appointments and follow\-ups, educating patients about our services, and creating an elevated experience from the first inquiry through checkout and post\-treatment follow\-up.

This position requires someone who takes initiative, pays close attention to detail, and understands that every patient interaction contributes to the Monarqui experience.

Patient Care Coordinator \& Medical assistant responsibilities

* Greet patients warmly and provide a professional, elevated experience from check\-in through checkout.
* Answer and promptly respond to incoming calls, text messages, social media inquiries, and patient questions.
* Convert patient inquiries into consultations and scheduled appointments through confident and professional communication.
* Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and manage appointments while maintaining an efficient clinic schedule.
* Follow up with prospective patients who have expressed interest but have not yet scheduled.

jobs.description:
**GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF THE POSITION**:

**Lead the Conversations That Change Lives**

Healing happens through connection, structure, and the right support at the right time.

In our programs, group work is a powerful part of that process — creating space for insight, accountability, and growth. The person leading those groups plays a critical role in how that experience unfolds.

**That’s where you come in.**

At Tatum Psychology Employment Group, we’ve built a full continuum of behavioral health services across the Central Valley and beyond — because access to high\-quality mental health care should be the standard, not the exception. Every day, our teams serve hundreds of individuals across multiple levels of care — many arriving in crisis and leaving with stability, skills, and hope.

As a **Case Manager / Group Facilitator**, you will be part of that impact — helping individuals move from crisis to stability and from isolation to connection.

This role combines **group facilitation and case management**, allowing you to build strong connections with clients while supporting their overall treatment journey.

You will plan and lead groups, support individual client needs, and collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to ensure clients are progressing and receiving the appropriate level of care.

This position is ideal for someone who is **engaging, organized, and passionate about helping others grow in a structured, supportive environment with Group\-heavy position serving two programs, with case management.**

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**1\.** **Group Facilitation \& Client Engagement**

* 80–90% of this position involves group facilitation, plan, organize, and facilitate psychoeducational and process groups using evidence\-based practices and program curriculum
* Create a safe, inclusive, and supportive group environment that fosters participation and growth
* Manage group dynamics and navigate challenges with professionalism and confidence
* Provide individual check\-ins, support, and crisis intervention as needed

**2\.** **Case Management \& Care Coordination**

* Support clients with resource coordination, goal setting, and treatment engagement
* Assist with discharge planning and continuity of care
* Act as a liaison between clients, clinical staff, and external providers
* Help remove barriers to care and support overall client progress

**3\.** **Treatment Collaboration**

* Collaborate with clinical staff to align group content and case management with treatment plans
* Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings and case discussions
* Contribute to treatment planning and client progress reviews

**4\.** **Documentation \& Compliance**

* Maintain accurate and timely documentation including group notes, attendance, and case management updates
* Ensure compliance with confidentiality standards, ethical guidelines, and regulatory requirements

**5\.** **Program Development \& Growth**

* Support development and improvement of group curriculum and programming
* Incorporate community resources and creative approaches into services
* Participate in ongoing training, supervision, and professional development

**ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS:**
